media:group.media:title: GSQ-RCO: Better Non-Uniform GGUF Quantization
media:group.media:description:
Michael Helcig (student at ETH, collaborating with ISTA DASLab) and Rush Tabesh (PhD candidate at ISTA DASLab) will talk about GSQ and RCO, two complementary methods for accurate low-bit LLM quantization. GSQ uses Gumbel-Softmax sampling to improve quantization, while RCO uses Riemannian optimization to allocate precision across a model under a fixed size budget. The talk will cover the ideas behind both methods, why they work so well together, and practical lessons from building the GSQ-RCO models released on Hugging Face.
